maddeler.e:
نتعارف (form VI)
# نَتَعَارَفُ (nataʕārafu) /na.ta.ʕaː.ra.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَارَفَ (taʕārafa)
# نَتَعَارَفَ (nataʕārafa) /na.ta.ʕaː.ra.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَارَفَ (taʕārafa)
# نَتَعَارَفْ (nataʕāraf) /na.ta.ʕaː.raf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَارَفَ (taʕārafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
